_meta.source: Curated per-arch-class performance expectations, seeded from the BD790i 24GB Blackwell NVFP4 catalog plus the MS-01 / Mac M4 CPU baselines. Repo-shipped (COPY'd tree) — privacy-first, no runtime phone-home. Merged additively into GET /api/inventory/enrichment under the 'model_meta' key.

scales.tok_s: generation tokens/second, order-of-magnitude expectation per size class

gpu_nvidia_single.label: NVIDIA single GPU (Blackwell class)
gpu_nvidia_single.notes: 24GB Blackwell reference (BD790i RTX PRO): NVFP4 weights via vLLM, continuous batching. KV cache competes with weights in the same VRAM pool — budget against the largest per-pool figure, not host RAM.

expectations.tok_s: no-fit on 24GB — offload or smaller quant

gpu_nvidia_multi.label: NVIDIA multi-GPU
gpu_nvidia_multi.notes: Per-pool placement; a model must fit its assigned pool. Tensor-parallel serving is a vLLM concern, not a catalog one.

apple_unified.label: Apple Silicon unified memory
apple_unified.notes: Mac M4 Pro 48GB reference. Unified pool — weights and KV share DRAM; swap-thrash, not hard OOM, is the failure mode.

cpu_x86.label: x86 CPU-only
cpu_x86.notes: MS-01 (20T DDR5-5200) and BD790i CPU path (32T DDR5-5600) references. Memory bandwidth bound; GGUF Q4_K_M baseline.

vram_notes.notes: Load-fit adds 15% KV-cache headroom on top of the quantized weight size (co_scheduler KV_HEADROOM_PCT). NVFP4 weights require Blackwell-class compute capability (>= 10.0); they are a hard no-fit on CPU-only hosts.

code_gen.notes: Pin coding-role models; low temperature for deterministic synthesis.

rule_writer.notes: Schema-bound output — pair with a json format parser.

analyzer.notes: Findings extraction; mid-size reasoning models earn their latency here.

retriever.notes: Latency-sensitive; smallest model that holds the context window wins.

composer.notes: Synthesis/creative; MoE creative models rank well.

validator.notes: Adversarial checking; prefer a different family than the producer step.

reviewer.notes: Peer-review persona; benefits from long context.

classifier.notes: Closed-vocabulary output; small reasoning models suffice.

decision.notes: Branch routing; deterministic JSON output required.

uncensored.notes: Abliterated-first ranking; refusal-free output is the selection criterion.
